title: Luigi's Mansion 2 HD
description: Luigi vacuums up ghosts across a series of haunted mansions, one bite-sized mission at a time, with a co-op tower mode for up to four.

title: Costume Quest
description: Trick-or-treat through the suburbs, a mall and a carnival, where your Halloween costume turns into the real thing in turn-based fights against monsters.

title: Costume Quest 2
description: The Halloween RPG sequel: travel through time to stop a candy-hating dentist, with costumes that become heroes in turn-based fights.

title: Pumpkin Jack
description: A Halloween 3D action platformer where you play the Devil's pumpkin-headed champion, smashing skeletons and crows across spooky levels.

title: MediEvil
description: Sir Daniel Fortesque, a clumsy skeleton knight raised from the dead, hacks through a cartoon-gothic kingdom in this remake of the PlayStation classic.

title: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow
description: A point-and-click folk horror mystery: a Victorian antiquarian comes to a remote moorland village to dig up a burial mound the locals want left alone.

title: The Last Door
description: A pixel-art point-and-click horror in Victorian England, where a letter from an old school friend pulls Jeremiah Devitt into something that should have stayed buried.

title: Creepy Tale
description: A short hand-drawn puzzle adventure through a dangerous fairy-tale forest, slipping past its monsters to uncover its secrets.

title: DARQ
description: Lloyd knows he is dreaming, so he bends gravity and the dream's rules to solve puzzles while staying hidden from what lives in the dark.

title: Sucker for Love: First Date
description: A comedy dating sim where you try to romance Lovecraftian elder gods by performing summoning rituals in your apartment without losing your mind.

title: Slay the Princess
description: A branching horror visual novel: you are sent to slay a princess locked in a cabin basement, and every choice you make changes who she becomes.

title: Ib
description: A young girl visiting an art gallery gets pulled into a living exhibit, where she solves puzzles to escape as the paintings turn on her.

title: The Witch's House MV
description: Viola wanders into a witch's house in the forest and has to survive its deadly puzzle rooms to get back out.

title: Corpse Party (2021)
description: Students try a friendship charm after school and wake up trapped in a haunted elementary school, in a pixel-art horror adventure known for its gore.

title: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
description: A branching horror mystery in 1980s Tokyo, where people given curse powers by local ghost stories compete over a ritual said to bring back the dead.

title: Emio - The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club
description: A detective adventure about a murdered student found wearing a paper bag with a smile drawn on it, and the urban legend that seems to explain it.

title: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark
description: Branded with a mark that kills whoever carries it, an amnesiac man investigates urban legends and the spirits behind them before it's too late.

title: Children of Silentown
description: Lucy grows up in a village surrounded by a monster-filled forest where people keep going missing, and sets out to find out why.

title: Rusty Lake Hotel
description: Serve the animal guests of a surreal lakeside hotel through point-and-click puzzle rooms, where every dinner hides something dark.

title: Rusty Lake: Roots
description: Grow the Vanderboom family tree across generations through surreal point-and-click puzzles, each branch hiding something darker.

title: The Exit 8
description: Walk an endless underground passage and watch for anything out of place: turn back if something is off, keep going if not, until you reach Exit 8.

title: I'm on Observation Duty
description: Work a night shift watching security cameras and report every anomaly, from moved furniture to things that should not be there.

title: Home Safety Hotline
description: Answer calls on a home safety hotline and identify the pests and household hazards callers describe, some of them stranger than others.

title: Amanda the Adventurer
description: Play old VHS episodes of a children's show starring Amanda and her sheep friend Wooly, and do what Amanda says, or she might get angry.

title: Fear the Spotlight
description: Two teens sneak into their school at night for a seance and the halls turn against them, in a short 90s-style horror adventure.

title: The Midnight Walk
description: Travel a handmade clay world with a lost lantern creature, lighting your way and outsmarting the monsters that lurk in the dark.

title: Killer Frequency
description: Host a late-night radio show in a small 1987 town and guide callers away from a masked killer, live on air.

title: Look Outside
description: Anyone who looks out the window turns into a monster, so you stay inside your apartment building, scavenge supplies, meet its strange residents and fight in turn-based battles.

title: No, I'm not a Human
description: Locked inside your house at the end of the world, decide which visitors to let in and which ones are Visitors pretending to be human.

title: That's not my Neighbor
description: Work the front desk of a 1955 apartment building and check every resident's paperwork to keep doppelgangers out.

title: Mundaun
description: A hand-pencilled folk horror adventure: return to your grandfather's Alpine village after his death and uncover a pact with the devil.

title: World of Horror
description: A 1-bit roguelite inspired by Junji Ito and Lovecraft: solve cosmic horror mysteries in a Japanese seaside town, with turn-based fights and runs that end differently every time.

title: Darkwood
description: Scavenge a cursed forest by day and barricade your hideout to survive the night, in a top-down survival horror.

title: Iron Lung
description: Pilot a tiny windowless submarine through an ocean of blood on an alien moon, steering by map coordinates and grainy photos.

title: Faith: The Unholy Trinity
description: A pixel-art horror trilogy inspired by 8-bit games and the 1980s Satanic Panic, where a young priest faces demons and cultists with a crucifix.

title: The Mortuary Assistant
description: Embalm bodies alone on the night shift at a mortuary while identifying and banishing the demons haunting them, before one gets to you.

title: Choo-Choo Charles
description: Upgrade an old train and explore an open-world island to hunt down Charles, a monstrous spider train.

title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 1
description: Return to the abandoned Playtime Co. toy factory and solve puzzles with the GrabPack's stretchy hands while Huggy Wuggy hunts you.

title: Hello Neighbor
description: Sneak into your neighbor's house to find out what he keeps in the basement, while he adapts to the way you play to catch you.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's
description: Survive five nights as a pizzeria security guard, watching cameras and rationing power to keep the animatronics out of your office.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
description: Spend the night locked in a huge mall-sized pizzeria as a boy named Gregory, hiding from rogue animatronics with help from Glamrock Freddy.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
description: Jump through a pizzeria ball pit that leads back to 1985 to save your town, in a pixel-art adventure based on a Fazbear Frights story.

title: Bendy and the Ink Machine
description: Return to your old animation studio and find it flooded with ink and haunted by a 1930s cartoon devil come to life.

title: Bendy and the Dark Revival
description: Sneak, scavenge and fight ink creatures as animator Audrey in the sequel to Bendy and the Ink Machine.

title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
description: Five friends on a diving trip end up on a WWII ghost ship in a choice-driven horror story you can play solo or with friends.

title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes
description: At the end of the Iraq War, US soldiers and their enemies fall into a buried Sumerian temple and have to work together to survive the night.

title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me
description: A documentary crew is invited to a modern replica of serial killer H. H. Holmes' murder castle and finds out they are being watched.

title: The Casting of Frank Stone
description: A choice-driven horror story set in the Dead by Daylight universe, where young friends get caught up in the violent legacy of killer Frank Stone.

title: The Medium
description: A medium explores an abandoned resort in both the real world and the spirit world at once, often shown side by side on a split screen.

title: Observer: System Redux
description: A cyberpunk detective hacks into suspects' minds to investigate a murder in a locked-down tenement in 2084 Krakow.

title: Blair Witch
description: A former cop and his dog Bullet search the Black Hills Forest for a missing boy, in a psychological horror set in the Blair Witch universe.

title: The Sinking City
description: Investigate a flooded 1920s New England city gripped by madness as a private detective, in an open-world Lovecraftian mystery.

title: Call of Cthulhu
description: In 1924, private investigator Edward Pierce looks into the deaths of the Hawkins family on a remote island and tries to hold on to his sanity.

title: Scorn
description: Explore a wordless biomechanical world of flesh and machinery, solving environmental puzzles with almost no guidance.

title: MADiSON
description: A first-person psychological horror where an instant camera links the living world and the beyond, and developing photos is how you solve puzzles and survive.

title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
description: Mina Park wakes up at school at night and has to escape a nightmarish district while a demonic pursuer hunts her, in a hand-drawn Korean side-scrolling horror.

title: Fatal Frame: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse
description: Girls vanished during a festival on Rogetsu Isle; explore its abandoned places and fight ghosts with the Camera Obscura, a camera that repels whatever it photographs.

title: Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water
description: Search a haunted mountain for the missing and the dead, fighting ghosts with the Camera Obscura across three playable characters.

title: Silent Hill: The Short Message
description: A free, short first-person Silent Hill story: a teenager follows messages from a friend into a decaying apartment block and flees a monster. It deals with bullying and self-harm.

title: Resident Evil HD Remaster
description: The 2002 remake of the original Resident Evil, remastered: explore the Spencer Mansion as Chris or Jill with scarce ammo and saves.

title: Resident Evil 0
description: Rebecca Chambers and convict Billy Coen team up on a zombie-infested train, switching between partners to solve puzzles.

title: Resident Evil Revelations
description: Jill Valentine boards a derelict cruise ship in the Mediterranean to find her missing partner Chris, with a separate Raid Mode for online co-op.

title: Resident Evil Revelations 2
description: Claire Redfield and Moira Burton, and later Barry Burton, try to escape a prison island in an episodic survival horror where a second player can take the partner.

title: The Evil Within
description: Detective Sebastian Castellanos fights through a nightmare world of traps and monsters with scarce ammo, from Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami.

title: Ghostwire: Tokyo
description: Nearly everyone in Tokyo has vanished, and you fight the spirits left behind with hand-gesture magic across an empty city.

title: Amnesia: The Bunker
description: Trapped in a WWI bunker with a creature that hunts by sound, keep the generator fueled and find a way out with whatever you can scavenge.

title: Outlast 2
description: A journalist searches for his wife in an Arizona desert ruled by a violent cult, with only a camcorder and nowhere safe to hide.

title: Clock Tower: Rewind
description: The 1995 point-and-click horror classic restored: Jennifer explores a mansion and hides from the Scissorman.

title: Alone in the Dark
description: Search a 1920s Louisiana mansion for a missing uncle as Emily Hartwood or detective Edward Carnby, in a reimagining of the original survival horror.

title: Dying Light
description: Parkour across a quarantined city by day and run for your life at night, when the infected get faster and deadlier, solo or with up to three friends.

title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
description: Parkour and fight through one of the last human cities after a zombie outbreak, where night brings out the worst of the infected.

title: R.E.P.O.
description: Up to six friends grab valuables from haunted places with physics-based hands while monsters hunt them, all with proximity voice chat.

title: Carrion
description: Play the monster: a shapeless creature breaking out of a research facility and growing as it consumes the people who held it.

title: Blood: Refreshed Supply
description: The 1997 horror shooter restored for modern systems: undead gunslinger Caleb takes on a cult with flare guns, dynamite and voodoo dolls.

title: The Sinking City 2
description: A survival horror sequel set in a flooded 1920s Arkham, where you explore the city, face the dead and confront an eldritch god.
